pairs.subject: agent-session-archive
pairs.evidence: src/features/notepad/NoteArchiveModal.tsx:35 In this context "archive" means a status change on a note the app owns (notepadStore.ts:771 `transition(id, 'archived', 'archive')`), not keeping transcripts a third-party harness writes and deletes. I grepped src/features/notepad for capture_manifest, claude/projects, cleanupPeriodDays and session_archive and got no hits. Its only uses of "transcript" refer to the app's own in-chat card transcript, so the subject's precondition (a third party deletes the source) does not hold.

pairs.subject: agent-session-archive
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/fleet_sessions.rs:24 fleet_sessions keeps only the harness's `claude_session_id` as a `--resume` key plus spawn metadata, and it deliberately leaves out output (lines 23-26). None of the context's repos or migrations copy, parse or retire harness transcripts. A grep of src-tauri/db/src/repos and migrations for capture_manifest, claude/projects, cleanupPeriodDays and session_archive found nothing, so no transcript archive exists here to judge.
